paragraphs.text: 用于 DeepSeek Harness 的模型配置插件，支持管理 llm-pi-ai 提供方、API 凭据、模型发现和单模型配置覆盖。仅提供增强模型配置，不修改官方模型配置页面
# dsh-custom-provider
Model tools embedded in the official DeepSeek Harness **Models** settings page.
简体中文
The official page manages providers, credentials, model lists, and reasoning capabilities. This plug
page manages providers, credentials, model lists, and reasoning capabilities. This plugin adds only:
- **models.dev metadata**: fill a model's name, context window, output limit, and supported text/ima

ge inputs.
- **Single-model JSON editing**: edit one model while preserving sibling models and advan

ced fields.
- **Configuration import/export**: transfer selected `llm-pi-ai` provider profiles witho
ut credential values or request headers.
The plugin registers no separate settings page and stores no separate model configuration.
## Requirements and installation
Tested with DeepSeek Harness **0.2.1-rc.2**, with the Web Settings surface and the built-in `llm-pi-
ai` adapter enabled. Older versions are not supported by this revision.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
For a local checkout, run from this repository:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Restart DSH and open **Settings → Models**. The existing official provider cards remain the primary
configuration surface.
## Model tools
Open a provider’s official **Edit** form, then expand a model’s **Model options**. Each `llm-pi-ai`
model has **Fetch from models.dev** and an inline **Edit JSON** disclosure in its own details. There
is no separate model picker or model-tools dialog. New custom providers use the same inline control
s no separate model picker or model-tools dialog. New custom providers use the same inline controls.
Fetching updates that row’s official form fields and JSON together, without saving. It imports only
`name`, `contextWindow`, `maxTokens`, and supported `input` values, leaving `reasoningEfforts`, `com
pat`, protocol settings, and credentials unchanged. Matching prefers the original full model ID, the
n its recognizable official provider, then the first matching bare ID. Requests share a six-hour in-
memory cache; a failed refresh never imports an expired snapshot.
Valid JSON edits immediately update the model’s native ID, name, capacity, input-type, and reasoning
controls. Fields without a native control, such as `compat`, stay in the same model draft and are i
ncluded when you use the official provider **Save** button. There is no separate apply action or aut
omatic settings write. Advanced fields still depend on the adapter’s schema and runtime support.
Your JSON spacing and caret position are preserved while typing. Native form edits update JSON autom
atically. Incomplete JSON or invalid visible-field values leave the form at its last valid state, ke
ep the original text, and block provider Save until corrected or reset. If native fields change whil
e JSON is incomplete, independent changes merge when the JSON becomes valid; competing changes to th
e same field are reported without overwriting either draft. **Reset JSON** reloads the current form
draft, not the last saved configuration. Collapsing a model retains its JSON text, and Save also wai
ts for metadata requests to finish.
[该节后续省略]
## Configuration transfer
**Import configuration** and **Export configuration** appear beside the official Models page title,
in the same order and toolbar position as the previous plugin. Their preview opens directly below th
ame order and toolbar position as the previous plugin. Their preview opens directly below the title.
Export selects configured provider profiles from the effective `llm-pi-ai.providers` settings, inclu
ding profiles configured in the official page or inherited from a base layer. It omits API key value
s and custom request headers. `deepseek-account` and `deepseek-official` are excluded. Endpoint URLs
may contain sensitive parameters, so inspect and protect the resulting file.
Import accepts the existing version-1 `dsh-custom-provider/providers` JSON format. The preview shows
source and destination model counts and whether each provider is new, user-configured, inherited, o
r layered. Existing providers default to **Skip**; new providers default to **Import**. **Replace**
updates the transferred provider fields and model list, preserving destination headers. Unselected p
roviders and the credential store are untouched.
The file retains `apiKeyEnv` names. An imported profile may therefore use an existing credential ref
erence on the destination. Configure missing credentials through the official page after importing.
Inherited layers and the installed catalog still determine the final effective settings.
Model writes use the official form’s save path. Imports use the official settings service, its schem
a, and the exact revision on which the import preview was based. An incompatible file or obsolete re
vision is rejected without silently adapting it.
## Upgrading from the independent configuration page
Existing providers and models already live in the official `llm-pi-ai` namespace and require no migr
ation. The old **Model configuration** navigation item is removed. The plugin no longer edits creden
tials or profile registrations, and no longer provides provider management, endpoint discovery, or i
ts own reasoning form.
The package name stays `dsh-custom-provider`, so existing installations can upgrade in place. Keep o
ne plugin registration; do not insert another `llm-pi-ai` adapter for this plugin.
